verdict.rationale: Clara's own marketing describes Clara Intelligence, which offers real-time spend insights, an AI 'Financial Analyst' partner that delivers insights before issues escalate, and an automated CFO agent with predictive insights. These are in-product AI insights from the user's spend data. The evidence is limited to homepage and product-page claims, with no feature documentation of what suggestions are generated or how they surface. The MCP integration is an external-assistant route, not in-product insight, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the insight and suggestion types and where they appear in the product, actionable recommendation mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Clara Intelligence™ Real-time insights that centralize and analyze all company spend
